text:
Elaine: FYI: Go SDK v2 is officially released. Docs + migration guide published: https://docs.redwood.inference/go/v2-migration. Breaking changes summarized there.

Sam: Any migration helpers?

Elaine: Yes, small CLI helper at tools/go-migrate-sdk (rewrites imports and common client initializers). Manual checks required.

Jess: I added redirects from old v1 pages to v2 and moved canonical examples to /go/docs/examples/v2.

Mike: Note: retry semantics changed (v2 fails fast on 4xx). Tests expecting retries will need updating.

Phil: Auth header changed from X-Redwood-Api-Key to Authorization: Bearer. Notify Dedicated/Private infra as some proxies strip custom headers.

doc-bot: PR #512 merged, changelog published: https://changelog.redwood.inference/releases/go/v2.0.0

Elaine: Deprecation timeline: v1 will be security-fix-only for 90 days then unsupported. Please open migration tickets for customer blockers.

Sam: Streaming interface changed to a Streamer type; added conversion snippet to migration guide.

Elaine: TL;DR: read the guide, run the helper, verify auth in infra, and plan migration within 90 days. Open docs issues for gaps. :tada:
